text:
### Process KRIs  
| Process | KRI | Target | Monitoring |
|---------|-----|--------|-----------|
| Account Opening | Error rate | <0.5% | Monthly |
| Payment Processing | Failed transactions | <0.1% | Daily |
| Fraud Detection | False positive rate | <2% | Weekly |
| AML Screening | Screening delay | <2 hours | Continuous |  
---
name: Chunk 24/32

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Error
raw_entities.description: Operational risk associated with errors occurring during the account opening process. The policy establishes a target error rate of less than 0.5% with monthly monitoring to ensure account opening quality and compliance.

raw_entities.name: Payment Processing Failure
raw_entities.description: Operational risk related to failed transactions in the payment processing workflow. The policy establishes a target failure rate of less than 0.1% with daily monitoring to maintain payment system reliability.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection False Positive
raw_entities.description: Risk of false fraud alerts generated by fraud detection systems. The policy establishes a target false positive rate of less than 2% with weekly monitoring to balance fraud prevention effectiveness against customer experience impact.
context: Fraud Detection | False positive rate | <2% | Weekly

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Delay
raw_entities.description: Compliance risk arising from delays in executing AML screening processes. The policy establishes a target screening delay of less than 2 hours with continuous monitoring to ensure timely sanctions and PEP list checks.
context: AML Screening | Screening delay | <2 hours | Continuous

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Error Rate Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Operational control that monitors the error rate during account opening processes on a monthly basis to detect and remediate quality issues. Target threshold is less than 0.5%.

raw_entities.name: Payment Processing Failure Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Operational control that monitors failed transactions in payment processing with daily frequency to identify and resolve payment system issues. Target threshold is less than 0.1%.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection False Positive Rate Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Operational control that monitors the false positive rate generated by fraud detection systems on a weekly basis to optimize detection accuracy. Target threshold is less than 2%.
context: Fraud Detection | False positive rate | <2% | Weekly

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Delay Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Operational control that continuously monitors the time taken to complete AML screening processes to ensure compliance with regulatory timelines. Target threshold is less than 2 hours.
context: AML Screening | Screening delay | <2 hours | Continuous
